question: What if the adult TTC fare rose by 50 cents, with Fair Pass unchanged?

call_breakdown.note: One call per unique decision state; identical states across arms and scenarios share a call. Latency and tokens below cover only calls made for this scenario.

agreement.unit: arm-decisions on the fixture-rule trajectory (tick-1 states count once per arm)

fair_pass_unchanged_by_fare.rule: Fair Pass riders whose legal options (cost, minutes) are identical in both arms keep the same Clef choice when only the adult fare rises.

context_adult_riders.note: Context only: adult riders do face the higher fare; a fall in P(transit) is directionally plausible, not a measured elasticity.

safety_sensitive_not_more_bike_bloor_aft.reason: This scenario does not change the Bloor cycle track.

paired_checks.note: Engineering face-validity checks on Clef’s choices for the same people in both arms; not empirical transport validation.

clef_run_summary.description: Full paired runWorldExperiment with Clef as decide; the mapped sandbox validated and committed every move.

replay_note: state hash = first 12 hex of sha256(JSON of the /v1/systemone body built by experiment/vultr-decision.js decisionBody); value = Clef choice. Enough to rebuild the Clef paired run offline.
note: Second opinion from Vultr Clef on the same legal options; the public run uses the fixture rule / Steven's persona agents. Not a Toronto forecast.
